**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation clause in either direction:

- **§5 Fees and Payment (p0023)** is the only commercial/pricing term and merely points to revenue sharing "as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit." It imposes no duty on AP to give Kubient terms no less favourable than third parties, and no duty to match third-party offers.
- **§1 (p0001)** cuts the other way in our favour, expressly disclaiming exclusivity and confirming the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties" — inconsistent with any implied MFN burden on AP.
- There is also no Kubient-granted MFN in AP's favour, so nothing to preserve.

The playbook's preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is satisfied as drafted, so per the rule's redline guidance there is nothing to delete. One watch-item for the deal team: because pricing lives in the Exhibits, any Exhibit should be checked for MFN or rate-matching language before signature.
